product.ta-1600-25.summary: The TA 1600/25 was one of three models advertised for office automation in Italy in 1984.
product.ta-1600-25.history: Triumph-Adler advertised it in July and August 1984 alongside the other two TA 1600 models in the campaign. It targeted businesses that needed management and tax applications.
product.ta-1600-25.technical.configurati: The reference helps locate the system software for this variant. The VzEkC inventory lists TASO Fehlerhandbuch TA1600-10-20-25 (1984).
product.ta-1600-25.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-1600-25.technical.limitations: The exact configuration still needs checking, and the firmware and boot media remain to be preserved.
